title: Induction of Adhesion-dependent Signals Using Low-intensity Ultrasound
protocol: Dissolve sulpho-m-maleimidobenzoyl-N-hydrosuccinimide ester in PBS at 1 mM.
Add 2 ml of the solution to each well and incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash derivatized surfaces 3 times with PBS.
Apply 2 ml of 10 μg/ml integrin ligand dissolved in PBS containing Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺ to each well.
Incubate coated wells overnight at 4 °C.
Heat 1% BSA, dissolved in PBS, to 85 °C for 13 minutes.
Allow the heated solution to cool and then pass through a 0.45-μm filter.
Wash ligand-coated surfaces 3 times with PBS.
Block coated surfaces with monoparticulate BSA for 30 minutes.
Add 25 μg/ml cycloheximide to 80% confluent fibroblasts and incubate for 2 hours.
Rinse cycloheximide-treated cells with PBS.
Detach cells from the culture flask using 0.5 mg/ml trypsin/EDTA.
Harvest detached cells by centrifuging at 500x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in DMEM/25 mM HEPES containing 25 μg/ml cycloheximide.
Count cell density using a haemocytometer and dilute to 10^5 cells/ml.
Incubate cells at 37 °C for 20 minutes to recover surface integrin.
Rinse ligand-coated, BSA-blocked wells three times with PBS.
Seed 2 ml of the cell suspension into each well.
Allow cells to spread for 2 hours at 37 °C, 5% CO2.
Warm the ultrasound emitter array and coupling gel to 37 °C.
Apply a pea-sized blob of coupling gel to each emitter.
Test that each emitter is functional using an ultrasound indicator diode detector.
Place the wells on the emitter array.
Return array to 37 °C, 5% CO2 and allow temperature to equilibrate for 10 minutes.
Switch on the ultrasound signal for a 20-minute duration.
Aspirate media after applying the 20-minute ultrasound signal.
Fix cells by applying 2 ml of 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS.
Incubate for 14 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate paraformaldehyde and rinse three times with PBS, gently applying down the edge of the well.
Transfer each coverslip from the 3.5 cm well to a 24-well plate.
Apply 0.5 ml of 0.1 M glycine in PBS to each well.
Incubate for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the glycine and rinse three times with PBS.
Apply 0.5 ml of 0.5% Triton X-100 (w/v) in PBS to each well.
Incubate for 4 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the Triton X-100 and rinse three times with PBS.
Block by applying 0.5 ml of 3% (w/v) BSA in PBS to each well.
Incubate overnight at 4 °C.
Stain vinculin-containing focal adhesion with hVIN-1 antibody diluted 1:400 in BSA block.
Incubate for one hour at room temperature.
Rinse three times with PBS.
Apply fluorophore (DyLight 488)-conjugated secondary antibody diluted 1:200 and TRITC-conjugated phalloidin diluted 1:200 in BSA block.
Incubate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse three times with PBS, then once with water.
Mount on a glass slide in an inverted position using Prolong Gold mountant.
Aspirate media from wells.
Place wells on ice.
Rinse wells with 2 ml cold PBS.
Aspirate residual PBS by leaving wells tilted for 1 minute.
Remove any remaining PBS thoroughly.
Lys cells on ice with 35 μl lysis buffer per well.
Scrape cells thoroughly to ensure complete cell lysis.
Leave wells tilted for 1 minute to allow lysate to pool.
Transfer lysate to an ice-cold 1.5-ml microfuge tube.
Spin at 21000 × g for 2 minutes at 4 °C to pellet cellular debris.
Transfer 180 μl of lysate to a new ice-cold 1.5-ml microfuge tube containing 130 μl of lysis buffer and 25 μl PAK-glutathione agarose beads.
Rotate tubes for 40 minutes at 4 °C to capture active Rac1 on the beads.
Harvest agarose bead conjugates by centrifugation at 2000 × g for 1 minute at 4 °C.
Wash bead conjugates three times with 500 μl lysis buffer.
Harvest beads by centrifugation at 2000 × g after each wash.
Discard supernatant after each wash.
Carefully remove any remaining lysis wash buffer with a 200 μl pipette.
Elute each sample by adding 35 μl SDS-PAGE loading buffer.
Incubate the mixture at 85 °C on a shaking heat block for 5 minutes.
Remove beads by centrifugation at 21000 × g for 1 minute.
Resolve bead eluate by SDS-PAGE.
Transfer the resolved sample to nitrocellulose.
Probe the nitrocellulose membrane for Rac1.
Initiate ultrasound stimulation on Sdc4 -/- fibroblasts.
Precipitate active Rac1 at 0, 10, 30 and 60 minutes after initiating ultrasound stimulation.
Blot crude lysates for vinculin to ensure equivalent loading between time points.
